title: By Grace, Through Faith
question: If salvation is not earned, what is it for?
blurb: Paul rules out boasting in one breath and names a purpose in the next. Follow both.

nodes.content: If salvation is not earned, what is it for?

nodes.verseText: For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God,
not by works, so that no one can boast.
For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
